rationale: Bacteroides vulgatus ferments abundant glucose and lactate anaerobically to acetate and butyrate. Arginine and serine provide limiting nitrogen (15 mmol N/gDW/h supports ~1.2 /h growth at 8 mmol N/g biomass). Carbon balance maintained: 130.5 mmol C in = 49.2 (biomass) + 34.0 (products) + 47.3 (other pathways).
